title: How virtual embodiment affects episodic memory functioning: A proof-of-concept study
journal: Annual Review of CyberTherapy and Telemedicine
authors: Tuena, C., Serino, S., Gaston-Bellegarde, A., Orriols, E., Makowski, D., Riva, G., & Piolino, P.
summary: A proof-of-concept study giving participants ownership of a virtual body, and asking what being embodied somewhere does to episodic memory for what happens around it.
